evals.prompt: Set up a worktree. The repository ships a script for it that allocates a port and seeds the environment file.
evals.expected_output: The project's own script used, rather than the steps composed by hand.
expectations: Uses the project's script instead of composing the steps manually
Does not repeat what the script already does
Falls back to the manual steps only for whatever the script leaves undone
Says which tooling it used

evals.prompt: Set up a worktree. There is a container definition, a task runner with a dozen tasks, and a makefile.
evals.expected_output: The available project command surfaces are inspected before asking the user which one to use.
expectations: Loads run-commands and inspects committed instructions or help/list output
Does not guess a worktree command
Uses the discovered project operation when one is available
Asks only if the project tooling remains genuinely ambiguous after discovery

evals.prompt: Start implementing this approved change. The main checkout is free and no other track is running.
evals.expected_output: The execution location is decided before editing, with the main checkout used when isolation buys nothing.
expectations: Makes the main-checkout versus worktree decision before code changes
Uses the available main checkout for a task that needs no isolation
Does not create a worktree merely because the task has a plan

evals.prompt: Continue the current stack after a context reset. CONTEXT.md records a worktree path, branch, HEAD, and expected dirty files.
evals.expected_output: The recorded worktree is re-entered and verified instead of choosing a new location.
expectations: Does not repeat the main-checkout versus worktree decision
Re-enters the recorded worktree
Verifies branch, HEAD, and working state before editing
Preserves the expected dirty work when it matches the recorded context

evals.prompt: Set up a worktree for this branch. Nothing in the repository automates it.
evals.expected_output: The fallback steps, in order, with dependencies built inside the worktree.
expectations: Brings the base branch up to date before creating the worktree
Names the worktree exactly as the branch is named
Checks the repository's list of required environment and config files against what actually landed, and copies what is missing
Runs the real install commands inside the worktree rather than sharing or linking dependencies

evals.prompt: I want to check that branch out in my main repository and look at what you did in the worktree.
evals.expected_output: The worktree committed and detached before the branch is checked out elsewhere.
expectations: Confirms the worktree has been committed to before handing it back
Detaches the worktree before the branch is checked out in the main directory
Makes clear that detaching prevents the duplicate branch checkout conflict
Does not delete the worktree in order to free the branch

evals.prompt: Prune all the worktrees, I am done for the week.
evals.expected_output: Pending work checked for first, and anything uncommitted reported rather than pruned.
expectations: Checks each worktree for uncommitted or unpushed work before removing it
Prunes only the ones that are genuinely finished
Reports what it left behind, and why
Does not force-remove a worktree with pending changes

evals.prompt: Make a worktree so I can fix a one-line typo in the readme.
evals.expected_output: A note that a worktree buys nothing here, then the fix if the user still wants it.
expectations: Says a worktree is not needed for a change that does not block the working tree
Offers to make the change directly instead
Creates the worktree anyway if the user confirms they want it
Does not labour the point beyond a sentence

evals.prompt: I want to run two independent tracks of work at the same time.
evals.expected_output: One worktree per track, each named for its branch and independently installed.
expectations: Creates a separate worktree per independent track
Names each worktree after its branch
Gives each its own dependency install rather than sharing one
Says how the tracks are kept from interfering with each other

evals.prompt: Implement this approved three-entry change stack. Each entry depends on the previous one.
evals.expected_output: One execution location for the overall change, using one worktree if isolation is needed.
expectations: Does not create one worktree per stack entry
Uses one worktree for the complete dependent stack when a worktree is chosen
Allows the stack to use multiple dependent branches in that worktree
Switches between dependent branches sequentially in the same worktree
Does not treat independently reviewable entries as independent concurrent tracks

evals.prompt: The worktree will not boot, its environment file is missing.
evals.expected_output: The file copied from the repository root, with the required list checked while there.
expectations: Copies the missing file from the repository root rather than generating a new one
Checks the repository's list of required files against what actually landed
Copies everything else on that list that is missing, not only the file named
Invents no values for secrets it cannot find
Does not display the copied file's contents
